content:
A damaged gas line sent a scare through two south Laredo neighborhoods Wednesday morning, prompting police and firefighters to tell residents to stay indoors while crews stopped the leak.

The break was reported around 9 a.m. on November 4 in the 5500 block of Border Collie Drive, according to KGNS. A construction crew had damaged the line, and gas was leaking in the area.

The Laredo Fire Department and the Laredo Police Department responded to the scene. Residents in the Wright Ranch and Santo Niño neighborhoods were told to stay inside and avoid the area while crews worked, and police said there was no evacuation order in place.

Repairs were completed and the scene was cleared around 10:57 a.m. on November 4, according to KGNS, with fire personnel remaining in the area to monitor conditions as the odor lingered.

No injuries were reported, and no damage beyond the gas line itself was reported.

Sources: KGNS, reporting on the damaged gas line in south Laredo on November 5, 2026.

title: Gas line break in south Laredo keeps Wright Ranch and Santo Niño residents indoors
